steps.content: [WhiteSands - Reef Sandworm]

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Damn it! You were in cahoots from the start...?!
Scotch's team breaks through and rushes onto the deck, but his expression is just as grim as the desert bandit leader's.
At this moment, both of them finally understood: Tuco is no pushover.
What backup hideout? What joint heist? Those scammers planned it all along!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey hey hey, be careful, don't get too close! My pipe won't spare anyone or anything. If I accidentally smash something, this ship won't be going anywhere!
Hella waves the pipe near the cockpit's door lock, grinning as she watches Scotch fume.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How does it feel to be played by the "scammers" you look down upon?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, look at your dumb faces! Your jaws are about to hit the ground. Are you really that scared? Furious?
Scotch doesn't take the bait, and lets out a low chuckle instead.
Bang bang! With a few gunshots, Scotch and the other security forces leap into action, taking down the remaining desert bandits on the deck.
The security team advances again, trying to surround Hella and reclaim the cockpit before more desert bandits arrive.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Heh... haha... you're talking about dumb?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Who got used by Tuco as a tool?

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: I bet they've seized the chance to run away again! Haven't you learned your lesson? They just sent you to die!
Scotch points his gun at Hella, savoring the anger on her face.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Oh, I get it now. No wonder your Chief let you out so easily. Keeping someone so weak is useless. That's why they sent you out to gather intel, so that you'll finally have some value!

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Hahaha! You know it yourself, don't you? You're the weakest Sinner there is. You can't even block a few bullets! You're not still cosplaying as the hero, are you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You f**king bastard...!
Scotch changes his tone, offering Hella a new deal.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: It's okay, you still have a choice.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: The MBCC doesn't value you, but we do! The security team rewards merit. As long as we team up and capture the Tuco bandits, you can gain a status higher than at the MBCC!
He stands only several inches away from Hella. Gazing at the trembling girl before him, he extends his hand smugly.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Money, status, fame, you'll have it all! You'll truly become someone <color=#fb9259>strong</color>!
[Flashback: Past events of Hella and the Tuco folks]

steps.speaker: Timmy
steps.content: It's... I learned how to make this dessert from Mira... and these are Hypercubes I got from three months of savings. It's not much, but I hope it helps...

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: But... the sandstorms are coming more frequently, and supplies are getting more expensive. Ultimately, it's because I haven't been a good sheriff for Tuco, otherwise Korryn wouldn't have to go out hunting for Hypercubes everywhere, and you wouldn't have been dragged into this.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: That's how it is in the WhiteSands. Resources are scarce, so everyone else is an enemy.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: But even Hypercubes won't necessarily keep you safe. Everyone has to keep fighting to survive... Even if you hadn't come, things would still turn out the same.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yeah, we're weak. There are many things we can't do or protect. Life isn't glamorous or carefree.
Mice are born into darkness, forever crawling where there's no light. They can't protect themselves, or their companions.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And I might really be the weakest, most gullible Sinner there is. No matter where I am, I get fooled easily...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But...
A little mouse got the chance to live in the light, and she hates always being so weak. So she left, seeking new adventures beyond the light.
The journey was bumpy. The little mouse met a naughty lizard, and also befriended the lizard's naughty companions.
The little mouse discovered... that the lizard was also quite weak, but had found another way to survive.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Maybe you're not strong enough now, and will make many mistakes... but that's okay. You have plenty of time. One day, you'll grow up, and become strong enough to face any challenge.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Don't rush, and don't feel sad about it.
There are things in this world that only the little mouse can do, and paths that only she can take!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: To do what I couldn't before, and to protect those I want to keep safe... I'm bound to get stronger, a million times stronger than I am now! Then I'll return to them! That's why I set out!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So until then, I ain't going down here!
The steel pipe swings down. Scotch sidesteps to dodge the blow.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Ha... haha, just as I expected, you're a useless piece of trash...

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: You think only one lowly B-Class can stop everyone here?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Who said I'm the only one here?
Scotch senses something wrong. He looks in the direction of Hella's gaze...
A group of people stand on a nearby sand dune, their silhouettes against the light.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Humming~

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: ...Korryn, you're off-key again.
The Tuco folks stand behind Korryn, holding various crude weapons. Maggie raises her vihuela, while little Timmy holds up Wright's portrait.
There is rare fervor in everyone's eyes.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: My my, little Hella grew to be so trusty in the blink of an eye! How wonderful.
Ready, aim, fire... Korryn's muzzle flares with the light of Mania.
[CG - Korryn Fires]

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Alright dears, the two dogs have started to bite each other! Now's the perfect time for us to plunder!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: If we miss out on today, who knows when the next big fleecing chance will come!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Little Hella is already at the front of the line for us. We Tuco folks have to pull our weight as well...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Let's go! Time to bring her back!
